title: Microglia mediate motor memory decay through activity-dependent phagocytosis of myelin sheaths
title_zh: 小胶质细胞通过活动依赖性的髓鞘吞噬介导运动记忆衰减
abstract: Experience-dependent changes in myelination are important for motor learning, with newly generated oligodendrocytes contributing to the formation of new myelin. However, motor memories decay over time and the underlying mechanisms remain largely unexplored. Here we show that motor memory decay is linked to changes in memory-associated myelin sheaths resulting from microglial phagocytosis in mouse brain. Mechanistically, reduced activity of motor memory engram cells lowers oligodendrocyte expression of the ‘don’t eat me’ signal from Cluster of differentiation 47 (CD47), facilitating microglial phagocytosis and driving myelin loss. Knockout of CD47 from motor memory-associated oligodendrocytes increased microglial phagocytosis of myelin sheaths and accelerated the decay of motor memory, whereas overexpression of CD47 showed opposite results. Moreover, microglia phagocytose myelin sheaths and synapses independently. Our findings reveal that microglial phagocytosis of motor memory-associated myelin sheaths leads to the decay of motor memory. Since various types of memory require myelination in the brain, this mechanism may contribute to the decay of other memory types. Hu et al. showed that motor memory decay involves microglia engulfing memory-related myelin sheaths. Reduced engram activity lowers CD47, a ‘don’t eat me’ signal, thus promoting microglia-mediated myelin clearance and facilitating memory decay.
abstract_zh: 经验依赖性的髓鞘化变化对运动学习至关重要，新生成的少突胶质细胞参与新髓鞘的形成。然而，运动记忆会随时间衰减，其潜在机制大多尚未阐明。本研究表明，运动记忆的衰减与小鼠脑中小胶质细胞吞噬导致的记忆相关髓鞘变化相关。从机制上看，运动记忆痕迹细胞活动降低会减少少突胶质细胞中分化簇47（CD47）“别吃我”信号的表达，从而促进小胶质细胞吞噬并驱动髓鞘丢失。运动记忆相关少突胶质细胞中CD47的敲除增加了小胶质细胞对髓鞘的吞噬并加速了运动记忆的衰减，而CD47的过表达则产生相反结果。此外，小胶质细胞独立吞噬髓鞘和突触。我们的研究结果表明，小胶质细胞吞噬运动记忆相关髓鞘会导致运动记忆衰减。由于多种类型的记忆都需要大脑中的髓鞘化，该机制可能有助于其他类型记忆的衰减。Hu等人发现，运动记忆衰减涉及小胶质细胞吞噬记忆相关髓鞘。痕迹细胞活动降低会降低“别吃我”信号CD47，从而促进小胶质细胞介导的髓鞘清除并促进记忆衰减。
